name: View Post Counter – Website Analytics
author: ThemesVila

sections.description:
View Post Counter – Website Analytics is a fast and lightweight analytics plugin for WordPress.

Track views for posts, pages, and custom post types without relying on external services. The plugin includes a clean dashboard, charts, detailed reports, and useful statistics while keeping your website fast.

Features

  • Track post views
  • Track page views
  • Track custom post type views
  • Modern analytics dashboard
  • Daily, weekly and monthly statistics
  • Interactive charts
  • Top viewed posts
  • Individual post analytics
  • Ignore logged-in administrators
  • Ignore search engine bots
  • Delete plugin data on uninstall (optional)
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • No third-party tracking
  • Developer friendly
sections.installation:
1. Upload the view-post-counter plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Visit Website Analytics from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your tracking settings.

sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with the latest WordPress version?

Yes. The plugin is regularly updated and compatible with modern WordPress versions.

Does it support Custom Post Types?

Yes. You can enable or disable Custom Post Type tracking from the settings page.

Can I ignore administrator visits?

Yes. Logged-in administrators can be excluded from analytics.

Can I ignore search engine bots?

Yes. Bot detection is included.

Will my analytics be deleted when I uninstall the plugin?

Only if you enable the Delete Data on Uninstall option in the settings.

Does this plugin use Google Analytics?

No. All statistics are stored locally inside your own WordPress database.
